app.name: GovGuide
app.subtagline: Discover verified Indian welfare schemes, check your eligibility in seconds, and apply safely on official portals.

home.heroTitle: Empowering Every Citizen With Government Welfare
home.heroSubtitle: Are you missing out on government benefits? Discover financial support, health insurance, housing subsidies, and farmer assistance designed for you.
home.step1Desc: Answer simple questions regarding age, occupation, and family income. No Aadhaar or bank details needed.
home.step2Desc: Our rule engine categorizes schemes into Likely Eligible, Possibly Eligible, and Not Eligible with clear reasons.
home.step3Desc: Check required documents and click directly to official verified government portals (gov.in / nic.in) to apply.
home.voiceBannerDesc: Use the GovGuide Voice Assistant. Speak in Telugu, Hindi, or English to discover schemes effortlessly.

schemes.title: Government Schemes Directory
schemes.subtitle: Explore verified central and state welfare initiatives with transparent eligibility criteria.
schemes.searchPlaceholder: Search scheme name, category, or benefits...
schemes.noSchemesFound: No schemes match your selected search criteria.

schemeDetails.disclaimerNotice: Important Notice: GovGuide is an independent informational guide. We never collect application fees or claim to have submitted applications. Always complete final applications on the verified official portal.

eligibility.title: Government Scheme Eligibility Checker
eligibility.subtitle: Fill in your profile details below to discover all government welfare schemes you qualify for.
eligibility.privacyNote: Your privacy matters. We do NOT ask for Aadhaar numbers, bank passwords, or confidential IDs. Social category and income are used strictly for matching scheme rules.
eligibility.incomeHelp: Total combined annual earnings of all members in your household.
eligibility.categoryHelp: Used solely to match affirmative welfare schemes (e.g. scholarships).
eligibility.likelyEligibleSub: You satisfy all known mandatory eligibility conditions for these schemes.
eligibility.possiblyEligibleSub: Additional information or documentation is needed to confirm eligibility.
eligibility.notEligibleTitle: Not Eligible Based on Known Rules
eligibility.notEligibleSub: You do not meet one or more specific criteria for these schemes.
eligibility.disclaimerText: Eligibility results are preliminary guidance based on available scheme information. Final eligibility is determined by the relevant government department.

voice.title: GovGuide Voice Assistant
voice.subtitle: Speak in Telugu, Hindi, or English. We will search government schemes and read the results aloud.
voice.unsupportedMsg: Voice speech recognition is not supported in this browser. Please use the text input below.
voice.q2: What documents are required for healthcare?
voice.q3: Which schemes am I eligible for?

auth.adminNotice: Authorized government administrators only. Unauthorized access attempts are audited.
